text:
Alex (PM): Quick sync — need to lock GA prioritization for customer-driven asks + SLA/monitoring/pricing exceptions. Target: Friday EOD.
Mira (Eng): ok. can we finalize priority buckets? I propose: P0 (ship at GA), P1 (post-GA 1-2 sprints), P2 (future).
Samir (Support): +1. Also need oncall runbooks for P0 features. Without runbooks we can't promise 24/7 support.
Jess (Docs): I'll own the "what's GA" doc if we can list owners for each feature. Send me the matrix.
Olivia (Finance): Pricing exceptions: we need a list of customers + expected monthly token usage to approve any custom tiers.
Nate (SRE): Two monitoring gaps: (1) per-customer tail-latency reporting (2) evicted-kv-cache alerts. Both needed for SLO compliance.
Priya (Legal): For customers asking for lower SLAs, we need CLA redlines and SLO carve-outs — share examples.
Alex (PM): draft matrix: 
```
feature,owner,priority,monitoring,docs,pricing_exception_needed
multi-tenant-routing,Mira,P0,latency-per-customer,Jess,no
slow-path-quantize,EngInfra,P1,kernel-fallback,Jess,maybe
custom-sla,CS,P2,per-customer-slo,Jess,yes
```
Link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/xyz
Mira (Eng): I can take multi-tenant-routing + slow-path. For per-customer latency we can add tags in runtime by next sprint.
Samir (Support): Who will write the runbook? @Mira or @Nate?
Nate (SRE): I'll draft runbook for KV-cache and fallback traces. Need sample queries from support.
Jess (Docs): Send me PR template: title, owner, summary, steps-to-verify, runbook-link. I'll populate GA doc.
Olivia (Finance): I'll prepare a "pricing exceptions" approval form. Put examples of expected $/mo.
Priya (Legal): I'll circulate a redline for SLA carve-outs. Expect turnaround 48h for small edits.
Alex (PM): Action items: 
- Mira: own matrix row for routing + timeline (due Wed 12pm)
- Nate: draft runbook (due Thu)
- Jess: GA doc skeleton + template (due Thu)
- Olivia: pricing exception form (due Thu)
- Priya: SLA carve-out template (due Thu)
If anyone can't hit these, say now. :thumbsup:
Mira (Eng): can do.
Nate (SRE): can do.
Jess (Docs): can do.
Olivia (Finance): can do.
Priya (Legal): can do.
Samir (Support): I'll provide sample customer tickets by EOD tomorrow.
pm-bot: Reminder: Friday GA checklist sync at 10:00am in #product.
Alex (PM): Great — I'll assemble final GA readiness checklist after items land. Thanks everyone.
